msg: Choose the gnomes based on their hat colour and shape. You will always compare the same pairs of gnomes, in my case blue and pink were always together and purple and brown were always together. Number of mushrooms appears to vary between 0-9. The best gnome will change over time, so if your score is going below about 4, try switching to the other gnome. I found that typically brown and blue were best at the same time, and purple and pink were best at the same time, but not always. Don't forget to hit spacebar to collect the mushrooms as it is possible to miss it.
